title: Crispy Fregola Pilaf with Mediterranean Flair
description: A gluten-free twist on the classic pilaf, featuring crispy fregola and a mediterranean medley of flavors.

ingredients.name: Crispy Pilaf
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade crispy pilaf

ingredients.name: Mediterranean Seasoning
ingredients.notes: A mix of oregano, thyme, and rosemary

instructions: Cook fregola according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add dehydrated tomatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until rehydrated and tender.
Add crispy pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with tomatoes.
Add fregola to the skillet and stir to combine with pilaf and tomatoes.
Season with mediterranean seasoning and salt to taste.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a serving dish and garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
